description: Returns one prompt in full, from an id given by search or the address of a prompt page: the original text that produced the video, its translation when there is one, the blanks to fill, the model, the video and the credit of its creator.

id.description: The id of a result of search, or the address of a prompt page.

language.description: Language of the user, as a code such as fr, es, ja, zh, zh-tw (50 languages). Titles, summaries and links come in this language, and fetch adds the translated prompt. Defaults to en.

name: fetch
title: Get a full prompt
